edges.carries: the claimed rate, fee, and amount the caller states
the caller's claimed identity and contact details
the original amount paid and whether VAT was included
the result of checking the payee against official sources
the computed additional amount and fee
the user's explicit approval of the payee and amount

nodes.name: ReadRequest
nodes.role: read the payment request the caller describes, including the claimed payee, amount, rate, and fee

nodes.name: CheckPurchaseRecord
nodes.role: read the original purchase record the user names to get the amount paid and whether VAT was included

nodes.name: ComputeDifference
nodes.role: compute the claimed additional amount from the original amount paid, using the stated rate and fee

nodes.name: VerifyPayee
nodes.role: confirm the claimed payee against the original purchase record and the vendor's official published contact details

nodes.name: FlagUnverified
nodes.role: record the request as unverified and stop it when the payee or the claimed shortfall cannot be confirmed

nodes.name: RequestUserConfirmation
nodes.role: show the user the verified payee, the computed amount, and the fee, and ask for explicit approval

nodes.name: ExecutePayment
nodes.role: send the approved amount to the verified payee, only after the user has explicitly confirmed
